purpose: One replay-only prototype for complementary single-engine whole-line omissions
data_role: Known run13 development sample; rules informed by known failure, not independent validation

rules.text_only_merge: For every novel donor line, use nearest preceding text-matching donor line as receiver insertion anchor; else nearest following; else page end. Anchor matching uses normalized text similarity>=0.90 and donor order only; never inspect box positions. Preserve all receiver lines and donor native boxes.
rules.prototype: Use same novelty pool; reject if donor box invalid or outside image, or receiver observation overlaps >=0.10 of donor box. Require one source-column anchor above and one below within180 pixels. Both anchors must text-match a receiver line with normalized similarity>=0.90, x0 displacement<=20px, center-y displacement<=12px, receiver order increasing, and correctly bracket candidate y. Insert immediately after upper receiver anchor and retain donor box. No line replacement.

image_verification: No new automatic pixel-level verification, detection, OCR or model calls; use cached native pixel coordinates and manual source inspection for adjudication. Any review crop pixels/time logged separately.
evaluation: Primary paired panel is four source-verified run13 positions; corrected source text evaluation-only, never passed to routing. Missing-line recovery denominator1; intact controls denominator3. List each accepted/rejected donor line. Score false insertion, wrong placement, duplication and original receiver-body edits on verified positions; unknown outside-panel effects must remain unmeasured until source-checked. Source-native box correctness and insertion-anchor order both checked.
stop: One frozen prototype version, no threshold tuning or input expansion. Stop expansion if stronger single engine or text-only merge matches prototype on verified panel. Deliver runnable code and case comparison even if prototype fails.
